headline: Ruble Loses Lead Among the Most Undervalued Currencies: Who Came Out Ahead
summary: According to RIA, the Russian ruble has lost its position as the world's most undervalued currency. The report compares currencies on valuation measures.
why: The ruble's valuation reflects Russia's sanctions exposure and commodity export dependence, which affect the Russian economy and its investors.
